title: test(rest): sandbox crash leak checks match a long unique marker, not the short word boom
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DGwpW37CMTDznXmHEda2Sn2)_

Fixes #25714

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

Test-only. The sandbox-crash leak checks matched the short word `boom` (plus `TypeError`) against the whole serialized response, and the import job id (base36 timestamp plus random tail) can spell `boom` by chance. The injected crash now carries a long unique marker, and the leak pattern matches that marker plus `TypeError` (a lowercase base36 id cannot spell `TypeError`). The check is no looser: any leak of the fault's words still fails it; no retry, no skip.

- `packages/rest/src/rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts`: new `CRASH_WORDS` / `CRASH_LEAK`; `sandboxCrash`, the `sandboxOwnFault` inner-hook row, and the three former `TypeError-or-boom` patterns (the CRASHED rows of the two tables and the inner-hook row) use them.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-sandbox-declared-status.test.ts`: same family (the `mapDataError` crash row); same marker.

Producer check: the real producer is the test sentinel itself (id from `rest-server.ts` import job creation); no product code changes.

## Verification

- `git grep -n` for the old whole-body short-sentinel pattern in `packages/rest/src`: no hits (exit 1).
- Both files via vitest at head 0728391a: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 589 passed (589)`.
- Ablation (committed fix first; mutation of `sandboxFaultAnswer` in `error-response.ts` so the fault's `.message` reaches the body; anchor hit 1 to 0, blob 77862fd5 to 25c0c58f; the mutated line read back from disk; source-resolved, no dist involved): `Tests  46 failed | 543 passed (589)`, e.g. `Expected: "Internal server error"  Received: "hook 'mz_guard' threw: TypeError: __OS_SANDBOX_FAULT_7f3a9c__"`. Restored with `git checkout HEAD`; `git status --porcelain` empty and the file blob hash equals the HEAD blob (77862fd5).
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 56 derived, 55 run exit 0, 1 NOT-MEASURED (`pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: only the rest closure is built locally). `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on a shallow clone, then 0 after `git fetch --unshallow`.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Both acceptance lines hold (see Verification). Test-only, so `skip-changeset`, no changeset.
- No out-of-scope findings.
